# Rect

A rectangle node. In `1.0.0`, corner rounding used the `radius` prop (renamed to
`cornerRadius` in later versions).

```tsx
<Rect width={240} height={120} fill="royalblue" radius={12} />
```

## Props

| Prop     | Type     | Description                          |
| -------- | -------- | ------------------------------------ |
| `width`  | `number` | Width in pixels.                     |
| `height` | `number` | Height in pixels.                    |
| `fill`   | `string` | Fill color.                          |
| `radius` | `number` | Corner radius (later `cornerRadius`).|
